text.text_excerpt: Been to this bar a few times! Makes for a great alternative to Half Moon if you are looking for something more low key. Friends have told me dogs are welcome but will definitely leave a tip when I confirm this with a manager on my next visit. The environment is cool and cozy, drinks are the same price and same availability as any other nearby bar. Music here can be on the bipolar side, I definitely don't mind it and after a drink or two I'm totally digging tunes! If you want a quick bite to eat I believe the bar serves some food but there is plenty of options nearby. Enjoy

This is a small, intimate bar. Nice selection of beers in bottles and a handful of higher end selections on draft. Very much a neighborhood establishment. The regulars are very friendly, conversations entertaining and the music that is often selected on the jukebox creates public sing-a-longs or private lip synching.

What I really like about this bar is how uncool it is. From the generic name to posters of the rat pack on the wall, this place is hipster kryptonite: utterly devoid of all irony. It's the exact opposite of the saint, a dive bar for people who don't like dive bar clientele, It's a bar for serious drinkers that pretends to be a cocktail lounge. a great place for adults to gather and drink. I guarantee that a cool kid won't last long enough to down a fuckin' shandy in this place once Doug plays "MacArthur Park" on the jukebox( it's like pepper spray to those kids).
